title: Prospective Binance USD-M full-L2 profit model

parent_experiment.statement: 0021 is a new experiment. It does not restore, amend, query or consume HY-EXP-0020 data or results.

independence.selection_rule: All model fields below are frozen before any 0021 Development data is queried. Any material change after preregistration requires a new experiment ID and a new preregistration.

capture_rule.capture_start_definition: The first complete UTC 4h boundary strictly after the HY-EXP-0021 preregistration commit timestamp.
capture_rule.source_timestamp_rule: Each L2 event, exchangeInfo snapshot, funding row and universe snapshot must have a causal exchange/observation timestamp and a local receivedAt timestamp at or after captureStart.
capture_rule.pre_capture_data: Any record with a source timestamp or receivedAt before captureStart is rejected from Development and recorded as PRE_CAPTURE_DATA; it is never silently clipped into the window.

time_windows.development_start_rule: developmentStart = max(proposed_development_start_utc, captureStart). If the preregistration occurs after the proposed start, developmentStart is the first complete UTC 4h boundary after the preregistration commit.

universe.selection_time: At each complete UTC 4h boundary, use the exchangeInfo and ticker responses received for that boundary before selecting candidates.
universe.depth_measure: Minimum of bid and ask quote notional within 10 bps of mid from the reconstructed full L2 book.
universe.missing_data_policy: Missing, stale, crossed or sequence-invalid depth excludes the symbol and never falls back to bookTicker or OHLCV depth proxy.

strategy_baseline.engine: Candidate -> Edge Model -> Net Edge Gate -> Portfolio Risk Gate -> Advisory

regime.sma_input: Completed 4h close prices including the current completed bar.
regime.bull_formula: BTC fastSMA > BTC slowSMA AND BTC close > BTC slowSMA AND count(eligible symbols with close > own slowSMA) >= ceil(0.5 * eligible universe size)
regime.bear_formula: BTC fastSMA < BTC slowSMA AND BTC close < BTC slowSMA AND count(eligible symbols with close < own slowSMA) >= ceil(0.5 * eligible universe size)
regime.sideways_formula: Any state not satisfying the complete bull or bear formula, including insufficient universe size, is SIDEWAYS.

candidate.channel_window: The prior 120 completed bars immediately before the signal bar; the signal bar is excluded.
candidate.breakout_distance_role: Feature metadata only; never expectedPriceEdgeBps and never a direct PnL estimate.
candidate.entry_price: The first fillable full-L2 executable book at or after decisionTime; theoretical bar open is not an entry price.

edge_model.output_units: Basis points of executable price return before fee and funding.
edge_model.model_cell_rule: Fit one separate model per candidate cell. BUY/BULL and SELL/BEAR observations are never pooled; no pooled-mean or breakout-distance fallback exists.
edge_model.insufficient_sample_action: edge.available=false; decision=NO_TRADE; no substitute estimate is permitted.

label.entry_observation: First fillable full-L2 executable entry VWAP at or after decisionTime and no later than max_signal_to_entry_latency_ms.
label.exit_observation: First fillable opposite-side executable exit VWAP at or after entryTime + 6 * bar_interval_ms and no later than one bar after the target.
label.formula: sideSign * (exitVWAP / entryVWAP - 1) * 10000, where BUY=+1 and SELL=-1
label.invalid_label_policy: Missing, stale, unfillable, crossed or sequence-invalid target book produces no label and is recorded as data failure, not zero return.

purge_and_embargo.purge_rule: For prediction at decisionTime t, a training label is eligible only when labelExitTime <= t - purge_bars * bar_interval_ms.
purge_and_embargo.embargo_rule: For walk-forward cutoff C, validation candidates begin at C + embargo_bars * bar_interval_ms; the embargo interval is excluded from fitting and validation.
purge_and_embargo.oos_training_rule: The model is frozen at development_end_exclusive_utc. Final-OOS labels never enter the final-OOS edge estimate.

features.atr_bps: clip(ATR30 / signalClose * 10000, 0, 5000), with true range using prior completed close
features.breadth_fraction: count(eligible symbols on the regime side) / eligible_universe_size
features.funding_carry_bps: clip(-sideSign * sum of the last three settled funding rates known at decisionTime * 10000, -50, 50)

feature_transform.winsorization: For each feature and cell, clip to training-only linearly interpolated p01 and p99 quantiles.
feature_transform.standardization: After winsorization, subtract training-only mean and divide by training-only population standard deviation; zero standard deviation uses scale=1.
feature_transform.fit_data_only: All quantiles, means and scales use eligible training rows before the prediction timestamp.
feature_transform.intercept: Add one unscaled intercept column after standardization.

training_method.method: Expanding walk-forward ridge regression separately for each candidate cell
training_method.refit_frequency: Every candidate decision after minimum_samples_per_cell is reached
training_method.objective: minimize sum((y - intercept - X * beta)^2) + 10 * sum(beta^2); intercept is not penalized
training_method.solver: Deterministic double-precision Cholesky on augmented normal equations; non-finite or non-positive-definite solve invalidates the candidate without fallback.
training_method.candidate_level_prediction: expectedPriceEdgeBps = calibrated intercept + calibrated standardized feature vector dot cell-specific coefficients; different candidate features may receive different predictions.

uncertainty_and_calibration.residual_variance: sigma2 = SSE / (n - effectiveDegreesOfFreedom), where effectiveDegreesOfFreedom = trace(X * inverse(X'X + lambda I) * X') and the intercept is not regularized.
uncertainty_and_calibration.standard_error_bps: sqrt(sigma2 * (1 + x' * inverse(X'X + lambda I) * x))
uncertainty_and_calibration.oof_predictions: Chronological out-of-fold predictions use only data eligible before each prediction; no row is scored by a model trained on its label.
uncertainty_and_calibration.calibration_fit: When at least 100 OOF rows exist in a cell, fit y = a + b * rawPrediction with ridge lambda=1, unpenalized intercept, and clamp b to [0.25, 4].
uncertainty_and_calibration.conformal_residual: q90 of absolute OOF residuals per cell using the linearly interpolated empirical 90th percentile; minimum 100 calibration rows required.
uncertainty_and_calibration.trade_uncertainty_rule: If calibration or uncertainty is unavailable, edge.available=false and the candidate cannot become an Advisory.

required_calibration_report.predicted_vs_realized: Mean predicted edge, mean realized forward return and mean signed error.
required_calibration_report.mae: Mean absolute realized forward return minus predicted edge.
required_calibration_report.rmse: Square root of mean squared realized forward return minus predicted edge.
required_calibration_report.deciles: Stable sort by predicted edge, signalTime and symbol; assign D1-D10 by rank and report predicted, realized and error means.
required_calibration_report.rank_correlation: Spearman correlation with average ranks for ties; zero-variance series is uncalibrated, not correlation zero.
required_calibration_report.primary_objective: Net expectancy and robustness; win rate is supplementary only.

dynamic_channel.window: Prior 60 completed bars excluding current bar
dynamic_channel.long_formula: Exit when a completed close is strictly below min(low[i-60], ..., low[i-1])
dynamic_channel.short_formula: Exit when a completed close is strictly above max(high[i-60], ..., high[i-1])

atr_stop.trigger: First executable opposite-side book crossing the stop price

profit_protection.high_water_mark: Best reconstructed executable mid after entry, updated only with received sequence-valid L2 events
profit_protection.long_formula: After activation, trailingStop = max(previousTrailingStop, highWaterMark - entryATR)
profit_protection.short_formula: After activation, trailingStop = min(previousTrailingStop, lowWaterMark + entryATR)
profit_protection.trigger: First executable opposite-side book crossing the ratcheted trailing stop

exit_model.same_timestamp_rule: If stop and channel share a timestamp, use the frozen priority. If event order cannot be proven from received L2 timestamps, mark invalid and exclude from promotion metrics.
exit_model.terminal_exit: Close an open paper position at the first valid executable book at final_oos_end_exclusive_utc; this is not a fixed 24-hour close.
exit_model.counterfactual_rule: Alternative exits are exploratory annotations only and cannot change the preregistered exit or any OOS result.

net_edge.book_type: Full reconstructed L2, up to 1000 price levels per side
net_edge.fill_method: Walk the adverse side of the book for the requested quantity; VWAP is executable price.

funding.source: Official settled funding rows with markPrice and eventTime captured prospectively
funding.expected_funding_bps: -sideSign * sum of all settled funding rates expected during holding period * 10000
funding.realized_accounting: Use every funding event from entryTime through exitTime inclusive with causal mark price; missing event or mark invalidates the trade.

net_edge.conservative_net_edge_formula: expectedPriceEdgeBps + expectedFundingBps - roundTripFeeBps - stressedBookCost - roundTripImpactBufferBps - roundTripLatencyBufferBps - 1.645 * uncertaintyPenaltyBps - fundingStressBps

gate.decision: Only a candidate passing cost, uncertainty, data-age, fillability and portfolio conditions can become a PAPER Advisory.

position_sizing.sizing_formula: quantity = floorToExchangeStep(min(equity * riskFraction / stopDistanceFraction, maximumPositionNotional, equity * maximumGrossLeverage) / executableEntryPrice)
position_sizing.exchange_filters: Use only prospectively captured exchangeInfo quantity step, price tick and minimum notional; missing filters invalidate the candidate.
position_sizing.rounding: Round quantity down to the captured exchange step; never round up.

portfolio_limits.risk_action: Any portfolio limit failure is NO_TRADE; limits cannot be lowered after observing Development.

data_quality_gates.invalid_segment_policy: Exclude and append an invalid-segment record with reason; no silent repair. Required-window coverage then fails closed if the exclusion leaves any required gap.

validation.method: Expanding walk-forward with six-bar purge and six-bar embargo
validation.primary_objective: Net expectancy and robustness, not win rate.
validation.counterfactuals: Exploratory only; excluded from all gates and OOS result files.

development_gates.gate_evaluation: All gates are conjunctive and frozen before Development; none may be waived or optimized after observing results.

collector_design.rotation: Rotate every UTC 4h boundary and proactively reconnect before exchange connection limits; each reconnect requires a fresh REST snapshot.

stop_rules.acceptance: This preregistration must be accepted before any 0021 Development query, model training, backtest, PnL calculation or Final-OOS read.
stop_rules.data_fail: Any missing required L2, exchangeInfo, funding, receipt, sequence, coverage, provenance or hash gate sets DATA_FAIL and STOP; no proxy or current-state fallback is allowed.
stop_rules.development_fail: If any Development gate fails, permanently deny access to 0021 Final OOS and create no result, trades or PnL artifact.
stop_rules.threshold_rescue: Do not lower thresholds, change exits, remove costs, alter filters or reduce breadth after observing data.
stop_rules.no_result_on_capture: Capture stage creates only raw data, diagnostics and immutable manifests; it creates no result.json, trades.jsonl or PnL.
stop_rules.final_oos_boundary: The Final-OOS window is immutable; any change requires a new experiment ID.
